main_body: A small wooden chair seen from the front: a slatted backrest panel (rows 2-6), a short seat band (rows 8-10), and two legs with a dark gap between them (rows 11-15).
top_band: Seat band at rows 8-10 (mid brown #9e684b, then a light front-edge row #d59147 at row 10). It is only about 3 rows deep and is partly cut by a dark row at 7. The backrest rows 3-6 alternate light and mid tones, which is a vertical face rather than a top.
evidence: The backrest is a flat front-on panel with slat stripes, so it is a vertical face with no horizontal surface above it. The seat is a thin 3-row band, closer to the guide's red 'thin seat: band 2' than the green 'top 5 + legs'. Rows 8-9 are the same mid tone as the backrest, and only row 10 is a lighter edge. The whole piece reads as a front elevation with a thin seat strip, not a seat surface seen from above. Fails the contract.

style.evidence: The candidate has only 7 distinct colours and a median of 7 per tile, against 38-40 colours and 17-20 per tile in the references. Its main wood ramp has about 3 steps (dark brown, mid, light), which is shallow next to the references' 5-6. 63% of its dark edge pixels are neutral, and there is a pure black (#000000) gap under the seat, so the outline is partly near-black sticker-style. There are no grain or texture dots; the surfaces are plain alternating stripes. It is much poorer than the references.
